name: Mickey's Smokestack BBQ St. Louis Pork Ribs
whyItWorks: Slow-smoked until tender, but St. Louis spare ribs carry high rendered pork fat and a black-pepper/paprika dry rub plus sugary tomato BBQ glaze.
prepOrOrderInstructions: In remission, eat 1–2 lean center ribs with excess BBQ glaze wiped off; during a flare, choose the Smoked Chicken Breast at the same counter instead.
watchOuts: Coarse black pepper/chili bark and HFCS/garlic in BBQ sauce
